suggestions.quote: Nobody suspects a thing. In a study of more than 1,300 Americans, people read a personal message (c20). Told it was written by AI, they called the sender lazy and insincere (c20). Told nothing, most never suspected (c20).

keep.quote: Around the turn of the century, the Philippines was called the texting capital of the world (c01). Every lit window is a chat. From up here, you see the dots.
In a 2023 study, people who suspected their chat partner was using AI-suggested replies judged them more harshly (c22). Using them made the conversation warmer and closer (c22).
